wrapperReview: The only wrapper change is a 60,000 to 180,000 ms whole-suite budget and an explanatory comment. reviewedBoundaries: Uses the actual ServiceAccessPrincipalAdapter and fixed consumer authority; owner/device are policy-bound and request JSON cannot select identity, observations, prices, endpoint or shell.
The service-access authority remains a public development fixture, not production buyer identity. Paid policy is not weakened by product source; explicit free policy appears in tests only.

AP identity is checked around reservations and final eligibility is checked after potentially slow AP I/O. Unknown sends retain local reservations, retries remain finite, and ordinary IP authorization is not inferred from message capability.
Pending queue sweeps while offline; refresh failure invalidates old link observation. Restart disables AP/admission, and policy expiry now stops AP without a user request.
Finite request count and per-tick selection, absolute Unix input deadline, request bound, generic errors, private socket checks, finally-close and bounded framed local transport inspected.
Published requirements of Mini standalone operation and all four display constraints are retained in MESSAGES.md without claiming physical acceptance.
limitations: No repository source edits, Git commits/merges, VM operation, physical Wi-Fi/WPA handshake, satellite RF, provider contract or real charge were performed by reviewer.
Local Unix/TLS tests ran with approval outside the filesystem/network sandbox because fixture socket binding needs that environment. They used temporary local services only.

The local modem supervisor is not implemented or accepted. It must authenticate the caller, confirm provider reservation and enforce all-traffic byte/cost/expiry before RF. Socket timeout is not proof of RF stop.

Arbitrary trusted modem observers, provider DNS/HTTPS and external environments have no independently accepted hard wall-clock deadline. This review accepts bounded scheduler iteration and tested local protocol I/O, not a real-time system guarantee.
Linux-specific SO_PEERCRED behavior and real Linux packet tests were not independently executed on this host in this review.

Full repository verify, dependency-install outcome, CI, Git save and main integration are separate parent/Git evidence. Parent-reported unrelated Zod/dependency failures and later reruns are not reclassified by this receipt.
